race.comment: Wide open. RAMASIS (1) is a promising type who has won two of four so far. Tackled tougher grade over further at Oakbank before a break but has been trialling very well and expected to be winding up strongly here fresh. LOSEYATOETOE (5) returns from a break and won maiden here last run before being tipped out. Has trialled well and has upside this campaign. Worth including. WHOOPS A DAISY (12) has been freshened and is going well. Winning chance with the right run. PURFECT LINE (2) has placed 5/8 here and can improve sharply on fresh-up effort. BOYD (3) resumes from a break of nine weeks. Finished sixth at his most recent appearance over 1000m at Morphettville Parks. In the mix.
